blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (PDEA-BARMM) and its partner agencies destroyed more than P51 million worth of illegal drugs and expired medicines in Maguindanao del Norte on Nov. 18. PDEA-BARMM Director George Paul Alcovindas said the illegal drugs were destroyed at the compound of private corn miller Lamsan, Inc. in Barangay Simuay, Sultan Kudarat town. Alcovindas said the destroyed items included 7,443 grams of methamphetamine hydrochloride (shabu) and 605.8562 grams of marijuana, with a combined estimated value of P51,202,784.0040.
